question: Can light escape a black hole?
short_answer: No photon can escape once it crosses the event horizon because the escape velocity exceeds 300,000 km/s (the speed of light). Space curvature inside the boundary directs all outward paths toward the center.
full_explanation: Einstein's General Theory of Relativity shows that mass warps spacetime. Inside the event horizon, the warping is so severe that all future-directed timelike and lightlike paths lead inexorably inward to the singularity.
